name: Bandana Bullet Kin
description: Slowly walks towards the player, rapidly firing bullets.
location: Keep of the Lead Lord, Oubliette, Gungeon Proper
tips: Fires rapidly — keep moving and use cover.
Basic enemy, low health — one or two shots from most guns.
ammonomicon: Aggressive Bullet Kin that fearlessly charge their targets, spraying bullets from their machine pistols with reckless abandon.

name: Veteran Bullet Kin
description: Slowly walks towards the player, firing multiple bullets in quick succession with 62% predictive aim.
location: Keep of the Lead Lord, Oubliette, Gungeon Proper
tips: Has 62% predictive aim — don't dodge roll in a straight line.
Fires in quick succession — wait for the full volley before repositioning.
ammonomicon: More experienced than their standard Bullet Kin brethren, Veterans have a better understanding of gunplay.

name: Tanker
description: Slowly walks towards the player, rapidly firing bullets. A tougher variant of the Bandana Bullet Kin with higher health.
location: Keep of the Lead Lord, Oubliette, Gungeon Proper
tips: Rapid-fires bullets — similar to Bandana Bullet Kin but tankier.
Moderate health (18.8) — use sustained fire.
ammonomicon: Tanker Bullet Kin are highly-disciplined hard-casings.

name: Minelet
description: Slowly walks towards the player, firing bullets with 40% predictive aim. Occasionally hides under its hard hat, temporarily deflecting bullets, then pops out and releases bullets in all directions.
location: Keep of the Lead Lord, Oubliette, Gungeon Proper, Black Powder Mine
tips: Hide under its hard hat to deflect bullets — wait for it to pop out.
Releases a radial burst when emerging — keep distance when it surfaces.

name: Cardinal
description: Slowly walks towards the player, firing bullets. Occasionally fires a cluster of 5 bullets that homes in on the player.
location: Keep of the Lead Lord, Oubliette, Gungeon Proper
tips: Fires a homing cluster of 5 bullets — break line of sight or dodge sideways.
The homing bullets persist — don't stop moving after they're fired.
ammonomicon: A high-ranking member in the Order of the True Gun.

name: Shroomer
description: Slowly walks towards the player, firing two bullets in a V shape.
location: Keep of the Lead Lord, Oubliette, Gungeon Proper
tips: Fires two bullets in a V shape — dodge between or around the V.
Moderate health (30) — slightly tankier than basic Bullet Kin.
ammonomicon: Shroomers are malformed Bullet Kin, prematurely fired, but somehow still functional. Prone to paranoia.

name: Ashen Bullet Kin
description:
Slowly walks towards the player, firing fast-moving bullets. Fires six times total before reloading, with the last three bullets having a 40% chance each to be fired with 100% predictive aim.
When spawning in a room containing decorative ash bullet kin breakables, there is a 30% chance that the Ashen Bullet Kin will not spawn normally. Instead, the Ashen Bullet Kin will disguise itself as one of the harmless breakables, only bursting out and becoming active when the breakable is broken, or after 2-6 seconds have passed.
location: Oubliette, Abbey of the True Gun, Black Powder Mine
tips: Can disguise as harmless breakables — watch for ash decorations in rooms.
Disguise breaks after 2-6 seconds or when the breakable is shot.
ammonomicon: Charred into ash by some great flame, these Bullet Kin can remain dormant for decades unless disturbed.

name: Mutant Bullet Kin
description: Slowly walks towards the player, firing bullets. Occasionally spits out a small cone of poison creep.
location: Keep of the Lead Lord, Oubliette, Gungeon Proper
tips: Leaves poison creep — avoid walking through its cone of poison.
The poison creep lingers — don't dodge roll through it.
ammonomicon: Living sealed in the filthy depths of the Gungeon's Oubliette has caused these Gundead to mutate.

name: Fallen Bullet Kin
description: Slowly walks towards the player, firing spreads of three fast-moving bullets. Leaves behind fire upon death.
location: Keep of the Lead Lord, Oubliette, Gungeon Proper
tips: Leaves fire upon death — don't stand where it dies.
Fire spreads — clear the area before finishing it off.
ammonomicon: These denizens of the Sixth Chamber delight in torment, pain, and costume parties.

name: Office Bullet
description: Slowly walks towards the player, firing bullets.
location: Keep of the Lead Lord (Boss Room)
tips: Found in the Bullet King's boss room — fires standard bullets.
Support enemy during the boss fight — clear quickly or ignore.

name: Office Bullette
description: Slowly walks towards the player, firing bullets. A smaller variant of the Office Bullet found in the Bullet King boss room.
location: Keep of the Lead Lord (Boss Room)
tips: Found in the Bullet King's boss room — smaller variant of Office Bullet.
Low threat — clear if convenient during the boss fight.

name: Western Bullet Kin
description: Slowly walks towards the player, firing bullets. A variant of the Bullet Kin that appears on mid-tier floors.
location: Gungeon Proper, Abbey of the True Gun, Black Powder Mine
tips: Standard bullet kin variant — appears on mid floors.
No special mechanics — basic threat management.

name: Pirate Bullet Kin
description: Slowly walks towards the player, firing bullets. A pirate-themed variant of the Bullet Kin found on early floors.
location: Keep of the Lead Lord, Oubliette, Gungeon Proper
tips: Standard bullet kin variant — basic threat.
Appears on early floors alongside regular Bullet Kin.

name: Bullet Fish
description: Slowly walks towards the player, firing bullets. A fish-themed variant of the Bullet Kin.
location: Keep of the Lead Lord, Oubliette, Gungeon Proper
tips: Basic enemy — fires standard bullets while approaching.
Low threat — easily dispatched.

name: Red Bullet Fish
description: Slowly walks towards the player, firing bullets. A red variant of the Bullet Fish.
location: Keep of the Lead Lord, Oubliette, Gungeon Proper
tips: Same as Bullet Fish — basic approaching enemy with standard fire.
Slightly tougher variant — same strategy applies.

name: Knight Bullet Kin
description: Walks sluggishly towards the player, occasionally firing an extremely slow pointy bullet.
location: Keep of the Lead Lord, Oubliette, Gungeon Proper
tips: Fires extremely slow bullets — easy to dodge but don't forget they're there.
The pointy bullet can be easy to lose track of in busy rooms.

name: Brollet
description: Slowly walks towards the player, firing bullets. Explodes violently upon death, or if the player comes too close.
location: Keep of the Lead Lord, Oubliette, Gungeon Proper
tips: Explodes on death or if you get close — kill it from range.
Keep your distance — the explosion radius is larger than it looks.

name: Chancellor
description: Sits stationary in the Gungeon Proper's bossroom if the Chancellor was spared on the previous floor.After taking any damage, or if 5 seconds have passed, the Chancellor's health is set to 20 and he will run madly towards the player.
location: Keep of the Lead Lord (Bullet King's room)
tips: Spared Chancellor appears on the next floor with revenge — kill or avoid.
If Bullet King is killed without harming the Chancellor, he stops charging.
Has 1000 HP initially — drops to 1 HP after any damage or when the boss dies.

name: Chancellor
description: Sits stationary in the Gungeon Proper's bossroom if the Chancellor was spared on the previous floor.After taking any damage, or if 5 seconds have passed, the Chancellor's health is set to 20 and he will run madly towards the player.
location: Keep of the Lead Lord (Bullet King's room)
tips: Spared Chancellor appears on the next floor with revenge — kill or avoid.
If Bullet King is killed without harming the Chancellor, he stops charging.
Has 1000 HP initially — drops to 1 HP after any damage or when the boss dies.

name: Old Chancellor
description: Sits stationary in the Old Kings bossroom.After taking any damage, the Chancellor's health is set to 1 and he will run madly towards the player.If the Old King is killed without harming the Chancellor, his health is set to 1 and he will no longer charge.
location: Bullet Hell (Old King's room)
tips: Same mechanic as the regular Chancellor — drops to 1 HP after any damage.
Spares if Old King is killed without harming him.

name: Red-Caped Bullet Kin
description: Chance to appear in random rooms after at least one Past has been killed. Does not attack the player, wandering aimlessly around the room.Does not deal contact damage unless it is jammed.If not killed in a room, it will eventually teleport away. Allowing 5 red-caped bullet kin to escape unlocks The Bullet.
location: Random rooms (after killing at least one Past)
tips: Does NOT attack — let it teleport away to unlock The Bullet.
Allow 5 to escape total to unlock The Bullet character.
Only appears after at least one Past has been killed.

name: Chance Kin
description: Runs away from the player and disappears if not killed. Turns into a cube which drops a random pickup upon death.
location: All floors
tips: Runs away — kill quickly or it disappears.
Drops a random pickup (hearts, keys, blanks, ammo) upon death.
ammonomicon: A relative of the Keybullet Kin, the Chance Kin can hide a variety of useful goods within their boxy heads.

name: Keybullet Kin
description: Runs away from the player and disappears if not killed. Drops a key upon death.
location: All floors
tips: Runs away — kill quickly or it disappears.
Always drops a key — prioritize over regular enemies.
ammonomicon: The Keybullet Kin are impish bullets that have abandoned malevolence for playful whimsy. They taunt Gungeoneers with their shiny casing and key shaped slugs, daring them to chase them during a firefight. If ignored, they will become bored and fade beyond the Curtain. Their lifeless bodies fit the silver locks found throughout the Gungeon.

name: Confirmed
description: Slowly walks towards the player, periodically firing four slithering lines of bullets.
location: Hollow, Forge
tips: Fires four slithering bullet lines — find gaps between them.
High health (45) — focus fire to take it down quickly.
ammonomicon: These robed Bullet Kin have taken steps to hide their transformation as they shamble madly through the gungeon.

name: Red Shotgun Kin
description: Slowly walks towards the player, occasionally firing a tight spread of 5 bullets. Has a chance to fire 6 bullets in all directions upon death.
location: Keep of the Lead Lord, Oubliette, Gungeon Proper
tips: Fires tight 5-bullet spreads — dodge through the gap.
Chance of 6-bullet death burst — maintain distance.
ammonomicon: Shells of the Red Kin are the beefiest and most durable of the Shotgundead.

name: Blue Shotgun Kin
description: Slowly walks towards the player, occasionally firing a wide spread of 5 bullets quickly followed by a wide spread of 4 bullets. Has a chance to fire 6 bullets in all directions upon death.
location: Gungeon Proper, Abbey of the True Gun, Black Powder Mine
tips: Fires two quick spreads (5 then 4) — dodge between the volleys.
Chance of 6-bullet death burst — maintain distance.
ammonomicon: Shells of the Blue Kin fire more rapidly than their Red brethren, though they are similar in most other respects.

name: Veteran Shotgun Kin
description: Slowly walks towards the player, occasionally firing a V-shaped spread of 5 fast-moving bullets with 100% predictive aim. Fires many bullets in all directions upon death that travel at varying speeds.
location: Black Powder Mine, Hollow, Forge
tips: 100% predictive aim on V-spread — dodge roll perpendicular to the spread.
Death burst fires at varying speeds — the slow bullets can surprise you.
ammonomicon: These mighty soldiers combine a sharpshooter's prediction with the area denial of a shotgun. Can be confused by erratic movements.

name: Mutant Shotgun Kin
description: Slowly walks towards the player, firing tight spreads of 5 fast-moving bullets. Always fires 6 bullets in all directions upon death.
location: Gungeon Proper, Abbey of the True Gun, Black Powder Mine
tips: Always fires 6 bullets in all directions upon death — clear the area first.
Fast-moving tight spreads — use cover or dodge between bullets.
ammonomicon: Like their mutant brethren, these malformed Shotgun Kin have been changed by the depths.

name: Executioner
description:
Slowly walks towards the player, firing chaotic spreads of bullets. Occasionally stops to fire 3 bullet chains towards the player, attaching them to walls. These chains disappear shortly afterwards.
Sometimes fires a bullet chain upon death, accompanied by a burst of 6 bullets in all directions.
location: Hollow, Forge
tips: Attaches bullet chains to walls — avoid touching them.
Death burst of 6 bullets plus a chain — finish it from range.
ammonomicon: Unlike other Shotgun Kin, these hooded shells have been granted minor Ammomantic power.

name: Ashen Shotgun Kin
description:
Slowly walks towards the player, firing 3 tight spreads of 5 fast-moving bullets.
When spawning in a room containing decorative ash shotgun kin breakables, there is a 30% chance that the Ashen Shotgun Kin will not spawn normally. Instead, the Ashen Shotgun Kin will disguise itself as one of the harmless breakables, only bursting out and becoming active when the breakable is broken, or after 2-6 seconds have passed.
location: Oubliette, Abbey of the True Gun, Black Powder Mine
tips: Can disguise as breakables — watch for ash decorations.
Same disguise mechanic as Ashen Bullet Kin but with shotgun spreads.
ammonomicon: Charred to ash by a great flame, these Shotgun Kin are animated by some external will.

name: Shotgrub
description: Slowly walks towards the player, firing spreads of bullets which release more waving bullets upon hitting an obstacle.
location: Gungeon Proper, Abbey of the True Gun, Black Powder Mine
tips: Bullets split into waving patterns on hitting obstacles — stay in open areas.
Don't hide behind cover — the splits will reach you.
ammonomicon: Nightmarish versions of Shotgun Kin formed in the Sixth Chamber.

name: Pirate Shotgun Kin
description: Slowly walks towards the player, occasionally firing a tight spread of 5 bullets.
location: Keep of the Lead Lord, Oubliette, Gungeon Proper
tips: Fires tight 5-bullet spreads — dodge roll through the gap.
Standard shotgun kin variant on early floors.

name: Western Shotgun Kin
description: Slowly walks towards the player, occasionally firing a wide spread of 5 bullets quickly followed by a wide spread of 4 bullets. Fires many bullets in all directions upon death that travel at varying speeds, as well as two giant bullets angled towards the player.
location: Gungeon Proper, Abbey of the True Gun, Black Powder Mine
tips: Fires two spreads plus two giant bullets on death — the giant bullets are the threat.
Death burst is large — clear the area before finishing.

name: Sniper Shell
description: Periodically aims at the player with a red laser, then fires a single high-speed bullet.
location: Gungeon Proper, Abbey of the True Gun, Black Powder Mine
tips: Red laser telegraphs the shot — dodge roll when the bullet fires.
The bullet is high-speed — react to the laser, not the bullet.
ammonomicon: The sharp-eyed Sniper Shells are easy to deal with on their own, but can pose quite a threat when providing backup to other Gundead.

name: Professional
description: Periodically aims at the player with a green laser, then fires a single high-speed bullet that explodes into bullets in all directions upon impact.
location: Black Powder Mine, Hollow, Forge
tips: Green laser telegraphs an exploding bullet — dodge the impact zone.
The explosion releases bullets in all directions — keep distance.
ammonomicon: Only the most talented Sniper Shells are called Professionals.

name: Gummy
description: Slowly walks towards the player, rapidly firing bullets. Occasionally pauses to summon a large jammed Spent that periodically shoots a spread of bullets in all directions.
location: Gungeon Proper, Abbey of the True Gun, Black Powder Mine
tips: Summons jammed Spent — kill the Gummy first to stop summons.
Jammed Spent shoots bullet spreads — clear them after the Gummy.
ammonomicon: Beware their dark incantations, which guide living bullets to their prey.

name: Skullet
description: Slowly walks towards the player, occasionally firing two spreads of triangular bullets.
location: Gungeon Proper, Abbey of the True Gun, Black Powder Mine
tips: Fires two spreads of triangular bullets — dodge between volleys.
Low health — quick to kill if focused.
ammonomicon: Skullets are Gundead that have been reloaded through dark Ammomancy.

name: Skullmet
description: Slowly walks towards the player, occasionally firing two spreads of triangular bullets. A tougher variant of the Skullet found on later floors.
location: Black Powder Mine, Hollow, Forge
tips: Same as Skullet but higher health — two triangular bullet spreads.
Tougher variant found on later floors.
ammonomicon: Skullmets are armored Skullets, and are consequently more threatening.

name: Spent
description: Runs towards the player and attempts to deal contact damage. Lunges when close enough to the player with a brief burst of speed.Killing a Spent will cause waves of more Spent to emerge from the ground.
location: Gungeon Proper, Abbey of the True Gun, Black Powder Mine
tips: Killing one spawns waves of more — don't ignore them.
Very low health (4.2) — AoE weapons or rapid fire clear them fast.
They lunge when close — keep your distance.
ammonomicon: The Spent are soulless Gundead, reloaded with no spirit inside.

name: Zombullet
description: Spawned by Gummies, always jammed.Sprints towards the player, periodically performing a close-range lunging bite attack (if they are close) or a radial burst of irregular bullets (if they are far).
location: Summoned by Gummies
tips: Always jammed — deals full heart damage.
Lunges at close range or fires radial burst at long range — keep mid-distance.
Only spawned by Gummies — kill the Gummy to stop the spawn.

name: Bomb Bot
description: Summoned by Fuselier.Waddles towards the player, attempting to deal contact damage.
location: Summoned by Fuselier
tips: Summoned by Fuselier — waddles towards you for contact damage.
Low health (10) — clear them quickly during the Fuselier fight.

name: Mouser
description: Spawns in huge groups.Sprints towards the player, attempting to deal contact damage. Moves slower the closer it comes to the player.
location: Keep of the Lead Lord (Boss Room)
tips: Spawns in huge groups — use AoE or rapid fire.
Very low health (1) — any hit kills them.
Slows down as it gets close — easy to pick off at range.

name: Creech
description: Walks towards the player, periodically releasing very fast bouncing bullets in all directions.
location: Gungeon Proper, Abbey of the True Gun, Black Powder Mine
tips: Releases very fast bouncing bullets — hard to dodge in enclosed spaces.
Bounces off walls — stay in the open to track them.
ammonomicon: The Creech is a demonic parody of the Shotgun Kin. Its false casing conceals a mass of pulsing eyes.

name: Hollowpoint
description: Floats towards the player, rapidly firing bullets. Periodically disappears and reappears elsewhere in the room.
location: Gungeon Proper, Abbey of the True Gun, Black Powder Mine, Hollow
tips: Teleports around the room — track its reappearance.
Fires rapidly after teleporting — be ready to dodge.
ammonomicon: Able to dematerialize and rematerialize at will, these spirits still cling to the combat they knew in life.

name: Bombshee
description: Follows other enemies around, frequently emitting a short-ranged shriek that destroys the player's bullets. If all the other enemies die, the Bombshee will launch itself at the player, exploding on contact.
location: Gungeon Proper, Abbey of the True Gun, Black Powder Mine, Hollow
tips: Destroys your bullets with its shriek — shoot between shrieks.
Kamikazes when alone — kill other enemies first or last, your choice.
The shriek is short-ranged — snipe from afar.
ammonomicon: Forever seeking revenge, these creatures emit shrieks that match the frequency of Blanks- negating Gungeoneer projectiles.

name: High Priest Candle Man
description: Summoned by the High Priest in Challenge Mode.Sits motionless, and does not deal contact damage. Dies immediately upon touching the player.When killed, bursts into a pool of infinitely burning napalm goop that lasts until the High Priest is defeated.
location: Forge (High Priest fight, Challenge Mode)
tips: Dies on contact with the player — don't touch it.
Creates permanent napalm goop on death — avoid the pool.
Only in Challenge Mode High Priest fight — plan your movement.

name: Candle Guy
description: Slowly walks towards the player, firing bullets. A candle-themed variant of the Bullet Kin found on early floors.
location: Keep of the Lead Lord, Oubliette, Gungeon Proper
tips: Standard bullet kin variant — fires basic bullets.
Low threat — appears on early floors.

name: Cactus
description: Walks towards the player, releasing rings of spiky bullets around its body.
location: Gungeon Proper, Abbey of the True Gun, Black Powder Mine
tips: Releases rings of spiky bullets — find gaps and dodge through.
Walks towards you — keep distance to give yourself time.

name: Rubber Kin
description: Attempts to launch itself towards the player, knocking the player back upon contact. Cannot deal direct damage to players, but does predict players’ movements.
location: Keep of the Lead Lord, Oubliette, Gungeon Proper
tips: Cannot deal direct damage — only knockback.
Predicts your movement — can knock you into other dangers.
Don't let it push you into pits or other enemies.
ammonomicon: Rubber Kin will attempt to knock their targets around, though they have no ability to deal direct damage.

name: Tazie
description: Launches itself towards the predicted location of the player, dealing damage upon contact.
location: Keep of the Lead Lord, Oubliette, Gungeon Proper
tips: Launches itself at your predicted position — dodge roll perpendicular.
Low health (12) — kill before it reaches you.
ammonomicon: Tired of being pushed around, Tazies are Rubber Gundead that have developed offensive capability.

name: Musket Ball Guy
description: Launches itself towards the predicted location of the player, dealing damage upon contact. Similar to the Tazie but with a different appearance.
location: Keep of the Lead Lord, Oubliette, Gungeon Proper
tips: Launches itself at your predicted position — dodge roll perpendicular.
Low health (12) — similar to Tazie but with a different appearance.

name: King Bullat
description: Periodically fires bouncing bullets in all directions. Spawns 3-4 Bullats and Shotgats upon death.
location: Gungeon Proper, Abbey of the True Gun, Black Powder Mine
tips: Fires bouncing bullets in all directions — the bounces are unpredictable.
Spawns 3-4 Bullats and Shotgats on death — clear the spawns.
ammonomicon: The largest known species of Bullat.

name: Bullat Gargoyle
description: Frequently fires bullets in all directions in a diamond shape. A gargoyle-themed variant that fires in a diamond pattern with higher health.
location: Gungeon Proper, Abbey of the True Gun, Black Powder Mine
tips: Fires diamond-shaped bullet patterns — stand in the gaps.
High health (45) — use stronger weapons.

name: Pinhead
description: Walks towards the player and explodes upon death. If the player gets too close, it will leap towards the player and explode.
location: Black Powder Mine, Hollow, Forge
tips: Explodes on death or when close — kill from range.
Leaps at you when nearby — dodge roll away from the leap.
ammonomicon: Pinheads live for the moment before their own brilliant combustion. Beware their leap!

name: Nitra
description: Walks towards the player and creates a line of explosions upon death, away from the player. If the player gets too close, it will detonate itself and the line of explosions will try to aim towards the player.
location: Black Powder Mine, Hollow, Forge
tips: Creates a line of explosions on death — don't stand in its line.
Detonates early if you get close — keep your distance.
ammonomicon: These tubular menaces signal airstrikes with the light of their lit fuses.

name: Claymore
description: Summoned by the Mine Flayer.Walks clockwise or counterclockwise around the Mine Flayer's boss room, exploding if the player comes too close.Invulnerable to most forms of attack.
location: Black Powder Mine (Mine Flayer fight)
tips: Invulnerable to most attacks — just avoid it.
Walks around the Mine Flayer's room — stay out of its path.
Explodes on contact — maintain distance.

name: m80 Guy
description: Walks towards the player and creates a long line of explosions upon death, away from the player. If the player gets too close, it will detonate itself and the line of explosions will try to aim towards the player.
location: Black Powder Mine, Hollow, Forge
tips: Creates a long line of explosions on death — do not stand in its path.
Detonates early if you get close — keep your distance.
Same mechanic as Nitra but with a longer explosion line.

name: Mine Flayer Bell
description: Summoned by the Mine Flayer. Wanders around the room aimlessly.Releases a ring of bullets on death.
location: Black Powder Mine (Mine Flayer fight)
tips: Wanders aimlessly — low threat but don't ignore it.
Releases a bullet ring on death — finish it from range.

name: Arrowkin
description: Walks towards the player then stops at a distance. Charges and fires arrows towards the player.
location: Keep of the Lead Lord, Oubliette, Gungeon Proper
tips: Stops at a distance and fires arrows — close the gap to dodge.
Arrows are charged — dodge roll when you see the release.
ammonomicon: The Arrowkin are primitive Bullet Kin from ancient days. Paintings found on cave walls have led credibility to the theory that ancient Gungeoneers were bison-like in appearance.

name: Blobulin
description: Quickly moves towards the player and attempts to deal contact damage.
location: Keep of the Lead Lord, Oubliette, Gungeon Proper
tips: Fast-moving contact damage enemy — very low health (1).
Any hit kills it — use rapid fire or AoE to clear groups.
ammonomicon: Blobulins form the lowest ranks of the Blobulonian Army.

name: Blobuloid
description: Moves towards the player and attempts to deal contact damage. Splits into two Blobulins upon death.
location: Keep of the Lead Lord, Oubliette, Gungeon Proper
tips: Splits into 2 Blobulins on death — clear the splits.
Chain: Blobuloid -> 2 Blobulins. Plan your ammo accordingly.
ammonomicon: When a Blobulon dies, it immediately spawns two vengeful Blobuloids.

name: Blobulon
description: Moves towards the player and attempts to deal contact damage. Splits into two Blobuloids upon death.
location: Keep of the Lead Lord, Oubliette, Gungeon Proper
tips: Splits into 2 Blobuloids on death — clear the splits too.
Chain: Blobulon → 2 Blobuloids → 4 Blobulins. Plan your ammo.
ammonomicon: An assault trooper in the Blobulonian Army, 3rd Division. Capable of subdividing upon death, and overwhelming their foes with numbers.

name: Blobulord Death Crawler
description: Left behind by the Blobulord upon his defeat.Crawls slowly towards the player. Cannot deal contact damage unless it is jammed.
location: Oubliette (after Blobulord defeat)
tips: Left behind after defeating the Blobulord — crawls towards you.
Cannot deal contact damage unless jammed — low threat.
Only appears in the Oubliette after the Blobulord fight.

name: Poisbulin
description: Quickly moves towards the player, leaving a trail of poison creep.
location: Keep of the Lead Lord, Oubliette, Gungeon Proper
tips: Fast-moving — leaves poison creep trail.
Very low health (1) — any hit kills it.
ammonomicon: Poisbulins, finally free of the excrutiating experience of being a Poisbuloid, march to the song of freedom and attack with abandon.

name: Poisbuloid
description: Moves towards the player, leaving a trail of poison creep. Splits into two Poisbulins upon death.
location: Keep of the Lead Lord, Oubliette, Gungeon Proper
tips: Splits into 2 Poisbulins on death — clear the splits.
Leaves poison creep — avoid the trail.
ammonomicon: The genetic process by which Poisbulons are created introduced a flaw in their replication.

name: Poisbulon
description: Moves towards the player, leaving a trail of poison creep. Turns into one Poisbuloid upon death.
location: Keep of the Lead Lord, Oubliette, Gungeon Proper
tips: Turns into 1 Poisbuloid on death — less splitting than Blobulon.
Leaves poison creep — avoid the trail.
ammonomicon: Poisbulons represent a terrifying advancement in Blobulonian warfare, leaving a toxic trail in their wake.

name: Blizzbulon
description: Fires triangular bullets in all directions, followed by 2 spreads of 3 triangular bullets towards the player.
location: Keep of the Lead Lord, Oubliette, Gungeon Proper
tips: Fires triangular bullets in all directions then 2 spreads of 3 at you.
Dodge the radial burst first, then the aimed spreads.
ammonomicon: Beware the Blizzbulon's circular spray, for it always precedes several targeted assaults.

name: Leadbulon
description: Moves towards the player and attempts to deal contact damage. Becomes enraged after taking enough damage, moving faster and leaving a trail of fire. Once enraged, will slowly shrink and lose health.
location: Keep of the Lead Lord, Oubliette, Gungeon Proper
tips: Enrages after taking damage — moves faster and leaves fire.
Once enraged, it slowly shrinks and loses health — just survive.
Don't get close when it's enraged — fire trail damage.
ammonomicon: Leadbulons form the heavy infantry of the Blobulonian Army.

name: Poopulon
description: Occasionally spins, releasing a large amount of spiraling bullets in all directions.
location: Keep of the Lead Lord, Oubliette, Gungeon Proper
tips: Spins and releases spiraling bullets in all directions — find gaps.
The spiral rotates — keep moving to stay in the gaps.
ammonomicon: A disgusting glob of waste. A Blobulon corrupted by decades spent in Bullet Hell.

name: Bloodbulon
description: Moves towards the player and attempts to deal contact damage. Becomes larger and slower as it takes damage. Releases many bullets in all directions upon death.
location: Gungeon Proper, Abbey of the True Gun, Black Powder Mine
tips: Gets larger and slower as it takes damage — easier to dodge over time.
Large death burst — maintain distance when finishing.
ammonomicon: An elite knight of the Blobulonian Army, 1st Division. Feasts upon combat.

name: Skusket
description: Has two lines of bullets orbiting it. Slowly floats towards the player, firing skulls that home in on the player and split into 6 bullets upon being destroyed.
location: Keep of the Lead Lord, Oubliette, Gungeon Proper
tips: Orbiting bullet lines — don't get caught between them.
Homing skulls split into 6 bullets when destroyed — shoot them early.
ammonomicon: Skulls of forgotten adventurers packed with black powder from the Gungeon's Mines.

name: Bookllet
description: Occasionally fires bullets towards the player in various patterns, such as R, N, and Φ shapes.
location: Gungeon Proper, Abbey of the True Gun, Black Powder Mine
tips: Fires letter-shaped bullet patterns (R, N, Φ) — learn the shapes.
The patterns are predictable — find the safe spots in each shape.
ammonomicon: These fiery tomes are required reading for initiate Gunjurors.

name: Blue Bookllet
description: Occasionally fires bullets towards the player in various patterns, such as R, N, and Φ shapes or rings of bullets that pulse back and forth.
location: Black Powder Mine, Hollow, Forge
tips: Fires R, N, Φ patterns plus pulsing rings — the rings expand and contract.
Time your dodge for when the ring is at its thinnest.
ammonomicon: These watery tomes are required reading for Ammomancy 201.

name: Green Bookllet
description: Occasionally fires bullets towards the player in various patterns, such as R, N, and Φ shapes or a large clover shape.
location: Black Powder Mine, Hollow, Forge
tips: Fires R, N, Φ patterns plus a large clover shape — the clover has gaps.
Find the gaps in the clover and position there.
ammonomicon: These tomes are only studied by students of Advanced Gunjuration.

name: Angry Tablet
description: Occasionally fires bullets towards the player in various patterns, such as R, N, and Phi shapes. A tablet-shaped variant of the Bookllet.
location: Gungeon Proper, Abbey of the True Gun, Black Powder Mine
tips: Fires R, N, Φ patterns — same as Bookllet but different appearance.
Moderate threat — learn the safe spots in each pattern.

name: Angry Necronomicon
description: Occasionally fires bullets towards the player in various patterns, such as R, N, and Φ shapes, rotating squares, circles, triangles, or Xs that predict the player's movements, or loose spreads of bullets in the players direction.
location: Black Powder Mine, Hollow, Forge
tips: Most complex Bookllet variant — multiple pattern types.
Includes predictive patterns — don't rely on static dodging.
High health (35) — use strong weapons.

name: Gigi
description: Flies towards the player, periodically spitting an egg that releases a swarm of squirming bullets towards the player.
location: Gungeon Proper, Abbey of the True Gun, Black Powder Mine
tips: Spits eggs that release swarming bullets — shoot the eggs before they hatch.
Flies towards you — keep distance and focus fire.
ammonomicon: Gigi are a strange species of bird that lays eggs filled with bullets.

name: Parrot
description: Flies towards the player, periodically spitting an egg that releases a swarm of squirming bullets towards the player. A tougher variant of the Gigi that appears on later floors.
location: Black Powder Mine, Hollow, Forge
tips: Same as Gigi but appears on later floors — spits swarming bullet eggs.
Shoot the eggs before they release the swarm.

name: Muzzle Wisp
description: Dashes three times in random directions, then releases a ring of flaming bullets. Leaves behind a patch of fire upon death. Sets the player on fire upon contact.
location: Gungeon Proper, Abbey of the True Gun, Black Powder Mine
tips: Dashes 3 times then releases a ring of flaming bullets — dodge the ring.
Sets you on fire on contact — avoid touching it.
Leaves fire on death — don't stand on its death spot.
ammonomicon: When the largest of guns are fired, the brilliant muzzle flash calls these Wisps into existence.

name: Muzzle Flare
description: Dashes three times in random directions, firing three bullets towards the player with each dash, then releases a ring of flaming bullets. Leaves behind a patch of fire upon death. Sets the player on fire upon contact.
location: Black Powder Mine, Hollow, Forge
tips: Fires 3 bullets with each dash — more aggressive than Muzzle Wisp.
Sets you on fire on contact — avoid touching it.
ammonomicon: These luminous orbs are not to be underestimated. Burning hotter than other Wisps, few who witness their glorious incandescence survive.

name: Cubulon
description: Frequently fires bullets in all directions in a diamond shape. A cube-shaped enemy that appears on mid-tier floors.
location: Gungeon Proper, Abbey of the True Gun, Black Powder Mine
tips: Fires diamond-shaped bullet patterns — stand in the gaps.
The diamond rotates — adjust your position as it turns.
ammonomicon: Ascendant Blobulons who have achieved flight. The force of their slam attack violently expels ammunition they store in their gelatinous body.

name: Chancebulon
description: Fires random attacks from other Blobulon enemies, along with groups of bullets that look like dice. Has a chance to fire multiple attacks at the same time, and has a chance to die instead of attacking.
location: Gungeon Proper, Abbey of the True Gun, Black Powder Mine
tips: Fires random attacks from other Blobulon enemies — unpredictable.
Has a chance to die instead of attacking — sometimes gets itself killed.
High health (50) — be patient and react to each random attack.
ammonomicon: Chancebulons are the berserker class of the Blobulonian imperial shock troops.

name: Cubulead
description: Fires bullets in all directions in a diamond shape, then pulls its bullets back towards itself.
location: Black Powder Mine, Hollow, Forge
tips: Fires diamond patterns then pulls bullets back — don't stand where they return.
The recall phase is the dangerous part — keep moving after the initial fire.
ammonomicon: Immune to damage when hardened.

name: Apprentice Gunjurer
description: Fires bullets in a variety of rotating shapes, such as a square, circle, triangle, or X that predict the player's movements. Occasionally disappears and reappears elsewhere in the room.Predictive aim is only applied if the player is more than 4.5 tiles away from the Apprentice Gunjurer, Otherwise, no shot leading is used.[1]
location: Gungeon Proper, Abbey of the True Gun, Black Powder Mine
tips: Fires rotating shapes (square, circle, triangle, X) that predict movement.
Predictive aim only applies beyond 4.5 tiles — get close to avoid leading.
ammonomicon: Less experienced than their fellow Ammomancers, Apprentice Gunjurers must hone their craft by ordering bullets into a variety of simple shapes.

name: Gunjurer
description: Summons 6 bullets, during which time any bullets fired at it will be absorbed. The 6 bullets along with any absorbed bullets are then fired at the player. Occasionally disappears and reappears elsewhere in the room.
location: Gungeon Proper, Abbey of the True Gun, Black Powder Mine
tips: Absorbs your bullets during its summoning phase — don't waste ammo then.
Fires absorbed bullets back at you — the more you shot, the more return.
ammonomicon: The School of Gunjuration teaches a mysterious form of Ammomancy, the art of producing bullets from beyond the Curtain.

name: High Gunjurer
description: Fires large rings of bullets at the player. Occasionally disappears and reappears elsewhere in the room.
location: Black Powder Mine, Hollow, Forge
tips: Fires large bullet rings — find gaps and dodge through.
Teleports away — track its position after each teleport.
ammonomicon: The High Gunjurers know exactly one more type of magic than their Red-robed siblings, and never let them forget it.

name: Lore Gunjurer
description:
Summons one of 4 bullet familiars, each with distinct behaviors.
Warrior: The bullet will home in on the player until it vanishes.
Rogue: The bullet will home in on the player and then teleport behind them in an attempt to catch them off-guard.
Mage: The bullet follows the player closely and will shoot smaller bullets at them.
Bard: The bullet will home in on the player, bouncing off of walls until it vanishes.
location: Black Powder Mine, Hollow, Forge
tips: Summons 4 types of bullet familiars — each has different behavior.
Warrior homes directly; Rogue teleports behind you; Mage shoots; Bard bounces.
Kill the familiars or the Gunjurer to stop the summons.
ammonomicon: Unlike their active brethren, the Lore Gunjurers prefer to study ancient texts over practicing Ammomancy.

name: Gunsinger
description: Buffs an enemy in the room, increasing their health and speed. They will cancel their spell and run away if the player is too close or they take damage.
location: Gungeon Proper, Abbey of the True Gun, Black Powder Mine
tips: Buffs a single enemy — kill the Gunsinger to cancel the buff.
Runs away when approached or damaged — chase it down quickly.
ammonomicon: An applicant to the School of Gunjuration, these neophyte mages crave the favor of their superiors.

name: Aged Gunsinger
description: Buffs all enemies in the room, increasing their health and speed. They will cancel their spell and run away if the player is too close or they take damage.
location: Black Powder Mine, Hollow, Forge
tips: Buffs ALL enemies in the room — highest priority target.
Cancel the spell by dealing damage or getting close.
ammonomicon: Gunsingers are capable of inspiring greatness from even the most pitiful of Gundead.

name: Ammomancer
description: Attempts to summon Shelletons. They will cancel their summoning ritual and run away if the player is too close or they take damage. If the Ammonancer is killed while their Shelleton is still alive, then the Shelleton will collapse.
location: Gungeon Proper, Abbey of the True Gun, Black Powder Mine
tips: Summons Shelletons — kill the Ammomancer to collapse active Shelletons.
Interrupt the summoning by getting close or dealing damage.
ammonomicon: Ammomancers are dark Gunjurers who have been banished from the upper levels of the Gungeon.

name: Jammomancer
description: Jams an enemy in the room, increasing their health, speed, and damage. They will cancel their spell and run away if the player gets too close or they take damage.
location: Gungeon Proper, Abbey of the True Gun, Black Powder Mine
tips: Jams a single enemy — jammed enemies deal full heart damage.
Kill the Jammomancer to stop the jamming — it runs when approached.
ammonomicon: A practitioner of a forbidden branch of Ammomancy, these accursed priests can convert a normal denizen of the Gungeon into one of the horrific Jammed.

name: Jamerlengo
description: Jams all enemies in the room, increasing their health, speed, and damage. They will cancel their spell and run away if the player gets too close or they take damage.
location: Black Powder Mine, Hollow, Forge
tips: Jams ALL enemies in the room — kill it immediately.
Runs away when approached — corner it or use rapid-fire weapons.
ammonomicon: The Jamerlengo is the grotesque pinnacle of Gunsinger magic. These bloated toadies can jam all Gundead in a room-shaped radius.

name: Wizbang
description: Teleports around the room, occasionally creating a projection of itself near the player that explodes into bullets in all directions.
location: Gungeon Proper, Abbey of the True Gun, Black Powder Mine
tips: Creates exploding projections near you — keep moving.
Teleports around — track its position to avoid projections.
ammonomicon: Wizbangs are known for their astral projections, deadly bullets that can traverse the ethereal planes.

name: Mimic
description: Rapidly fires bullets towards the player with different patterns depending on the quality of the chest. Drops items and/or pickups upon death. When the player attempts to open a Mimic or shoot it for the first time, it will shoot a jammed shot at the player that explodes into six bullets on contact with a wall or after traveling a certain distance.
location: Any floor (disguised as chests)
tips: Quality of the chest determines its health and bullet patterns.
First shot triggers a jammed bullet — dodge immediately.
Shoot chests from a distance to reveal mimics safely.
ammonomicon: Mimics are very dangerous, as many Gungeoneers foolishly drop their guard around treasure chests.

name: Gun Fairy
description: Wanders around the room, rapidly firing bullets towards the player. Occasionally spawned by breaking pots.
location: All floors (from breaking pots)
tips: Spawns from breaking pots — be cautious around decorative pots.
Fires rapidly — low health, kill quickly.
Can be captured with the Bottle for later healing.
ammonomicon: This malevolent spirit lives inside pots found in the Gungeon.

name: Bullat
description: Launches itself at the player, dying in the process.
location: Keep of the Lead Lord, Oubliette, Gungeon Proper
tips: Launches itself at you and dies — dodge roll perpendicular.
Very low health (1) — dies on contact with anything.
ammonomicon: The bats that once nested here have been transformed by the great Bullet.

name: Shotgat
description: Launches two projectiles in a V shape at the player, dying in the process.
location: Keep of the Lead Lord, Oubliette, Gungeon Proper
tips: Launches a V-shaped projectile pair then dies — dodge the V.
Very low health (2) — minimal threat individually.
ammonomicon: Shotgats split themselves in two, firing in a V shape. Their aim can be foiled by remaining still.

name: Grenat
description: Launches an exploding projectile at the player, dying in the process.
location: Gungeon Proper, Abbey of the True Gun, Black Powder Mine
tips: Launches an exploding projectile then dies — dodge the projectile.
The explosion is the only threat — avoid the impact zone.
ammonomicon: Grenats explode on impact.

name: Spirat
description: Launches itself at the player, dying in the process. Predicts the player's movements, and can reposition itself several times before hitting walls.
location: Black Powder Mine, Hollow, Forge
tips: Predicts your movement and repositions — don't dodge in a straight line.
Launches itself at you — dodge roll perpendicular to its charge.
ammonomicon: The ghosts of Bullats who died valiantly, returned from beyond the Curtain.

name: Coaler
description: Occasionally fires bullets at the player. Catches on fire upon taking damage, running around erratically and sending flaming bullets out in random directions.
location: Black Powder Mine
tips: Catches fire when damaged — runs erratically and fires flaming bullets.
Kill it quickly before it sets the room on fire.
ammonomicon: The Coaler is an unrefined piece of coal that has taken up arms, though it is unclear that they are as purposeful as the Gundead.

name: Gat
description: Bounces around the room and deflects bullets. Occasionally opens up to fire three spreads of four bullets towards the player.
location: Black Powder Mine
tips: Deflects bullets when closed — only shoot when it opens.
Bounces around the room — track its movement to avoid contact.
ammonomicon: Gats are mechanized sentries, built by some savvy adventurer in years past.

name: Det
description: Periodically fires four lasers in a + or × formation. Explodes upon death.
location: Black Powder Mine
tips: Fires 4 lasers in + or × formation — stand in the gaps.
Explodes on death — maintain distance when finishing it.
ammonomicon: Fires lasers in four directions and explodes on death.

name: Gunzookie
description: Periodically spits up bubbles that, upon popping, fire a bullet that predicts the player's movements.
location: Black Powder Mine
tips: Bubbles predict your movement — don't walk into the bubble pop zone.
Pop the bubbles before they fire — shoot them from range.
ammonomicon: The immature spawn of some great beast.

name: Gunzockie
description: Periodically spits up four bubbles that, upon popping, fire a bullet that predicts the player's movements.
location: Black Powder Mine, Hollow, Forge
tips: Spits 4 bubbles at once — more coverage than Gunzookie.
Pop bubbles quickly — they fire predicting bullets.
ammonomicon: The immature spawn of some great beast.

name: Bullet Shark
description: Charges towards the player, releasing bullets to the sides of itself.
location: Black Powder Mine, Hollow
tips: Charges and releases bullets to its sides — dodge the charge and the side fire.
Moderate threat — appears in Black Powder Mine and Hollow.
ammonomicon: Leaves a wake of bullets.

name: Great Bullet Shark
description: Charges towards the player, releasing many bullets to the sides of itself.
location: Hollow, Forge
tips: Charges and releases many bullets to the sides — avoid its flanks.
Tougher than Bullet Shark — appears on later floors.
ammonomicon: A bullet shark that has grown larger and faster.

name: Tombstoner
description: Walks towards the player, firing bullets in a cross formation.
location: Black Powder Mine, Hollow, Forge, Bullet Hell
tips: Fires bullets in a cross formation — stand diagonal to it.
The cross has 4 lines — dodge roll through one line.
ammonomicon: These marbled minions of the Lich serve as his personal guard, and stand vigilantly to protect him, tombstone to a grave.

name: KBullet
description: Walks towards the player, firing bullets in a cross formation. A Bullet Hell variant of the Tombstoner, found only in the deepest chamber.
location: Bullet Hell
tips: Fires bullets in a cross formation — same as Tombstoner.
Found only in Bullet Hell — tougher variant.

name: Kalibullet
description: Slowly walks towards the player, occasionally firing two spreads of bullets.
location: Bullet Hell
tips: Fires two spreads of bullets — dodge between the volleys.
Found in Bullet Hell — related to Kaliber lore.

name: Gun Cultist
description: Erratically moves around the room and wildly shoots at the player. Has the ability to dodge roll.
location: Gungeon Proper, Abbey of the True Gun, Black Powder Mine
tips: Can dodge roll — time your shots for after their dodge.
Erratic movement and wild shooting — unpredictable, keep distance.
ammonomicon: Forgoing the desire to leave or change the past, these fanatical worshippers of the Gun are erratic and unpredictable.

name: Beadie
description: Fires bullets towards the player and explodes upon death.
location: Gungeon Proper, Abbey of the True Gun, Black Powder Mine
tips: Fires bullets and explodes on death — finish from range.
The death explosion can catch you off guard — maintain distance.
ammonomicon: A thrall to the will of the Beholster.

name: Snake Guy
description: Slowly walks towards the player, occasionally firing a V-shaped spread of 5 fast-moving bullets and predicting the player's movements.
location: Gungeon Proper, Abbey of the True Gun, Black Powder Mine
tips: Fires V-shaped spreads with predictive aim — dodge perpendicular.
Fast-moving bullets — react quickly to the spread.

name: Ammoconda Ball
description: Summoned by the Ammoconda.Sits stationary, occasionally firing a single bullet towards the player.The Ammoconda can eat the ball, killing it and buffing itself.
location: Keep of the Lead Lord (Ammoconda fight)
tips: Stationary — fires single bullets periodically.
The Ammoconda eats it to buff itself — kill the balls to prevent buffs.
High health (75) — not worth the ammo to kill, focus the Ammoconda instead.

name: Cylinder
description: Drifts towards the player, firing semi-random spreads of triangle shaped bullets.
location: Gungeon Proper, Abbey of the True Gun, Black Powder Mine
tips: Drifts towards you firing triangle spreads — semi-random patterns.
The spreads are unpredictable — keep mobile.

name: Red Cylinder
description: Drifts towards the player, firing semi-random spreads of triangle shaped bullets. A tougher variant of the Cylinder that appears on later floors.
location: Black Powder Mine, Hollow, Forge
tips: Same as Cylinder but appears on later floors — semi-random triangle spreads.
Tougher variant — found in Black Powder Mine and beyond.

name: Gun Nut
description: Periodically strikes the ground with its sword, releasing a wide 90 degree arc of bullets towards the player. Can only aim in the eight compass directions.
location: Gungeon Proper, Abbey of the True Gun, Black Powder Mine
tips: Sword arc covers 90 degrees — dodge roll through the gap.
Can only aim in 8 compass directions — stay diagonal to it.
High health (100) — use high-DPS weapons.
ammonomicon: The Gun Nut commands lesser Gundead with the authority of the Bullet King, and patrols the halls of the Gungeon with a mighty blade forged from pure bullets.

name: Spectral Gun Nut
description: Periodically fires a wide 90 degree arc of bullets towards the player, along with a larger jammed bullet that explodes into bullets in all directions upon impact.
location: Black Powder Mine, Hollow, Forge, Bullet Hell
tips: Fires a jammed bullet that explodes on impact — dodge the explosion zone.
The jammed bullet deals full heart damage — prioritize dodging it.
ammonomicon: High-ranking Gun Nuts who continue to serve, though their armor has fallen to disrepair.

name: Chain Gunner
description: Slowly walks towards the player while swinging a ball and chain made of bullets. If it is the only enemy left in the room, its eyes will glow red and it will launch the ball and chain at the player.
location: Gungeon Proper, Abbey of the True Gun, Black Powder Mine
tips: Swings a ball-and-chain of bullets — stay outside the swing radius.
Launches the chain when alone — dodge roll when its eyes glow red.
ammonomicon: The Chain Gunners are the remnant of a lost legion of Gun Nuts, famous for their unique weaponry.

name: Fungun
description: Periodically releases clouds of bullets. Leaves a small pool of poison creep upon death.
location: Keep of the Lead Lord, Oubliette, Gungeon Proper
tips: Releases clouds of bullets — find gaps and dodge through.
Leaves poison creep on death — avoid its death spot.
ammonomicon: The mushroom child. These myconids have adapted to the Gungeon, launching a deadly cloud of bullets in place of spores.

name: Spogre
description: Periodically releases large clouds of bullets. Releases a smaller cloud of bullets upon death.
location: Gungeon Proper, Abbey of the True Gun, Black Powder Mine
tips: Releases large clouds of bullets — find gaps in the clouds.
Also releases a smaller cloud on death — don't stand near it when finishing.
High health (60) — use strong weapons.
ammonomicon: The mushroom parent. Spogres tower over their Fungun children, and their bullet clouds are correspondingly large.

name: Mountain Cube
description: Slides towards the player if they line up with it horizontally or vertically. Can be killed, causing it to explode and freeze any other enemies inside the blast radius. The explosion cannot damage the player. Dies upon completing the room.
location: Black Powder Mine
tips: Slides along rows/columns — don't line up with it.
Can be killed to freeze other enemies in the blast — use it strategically.
The freeze blast doesn't damage you — safe to trigger.
ammonomicon: These stout defenders assault intruders in any direction that can be described as horizontal or vertical.

name: Lead Cube
description: Slides towards the player if they line up with it horizontally or vertically. Cannot be killed until the room is completed.
location: Black Powder Mine, Hollow, Forge
tips: Invulnerable until the room is completed — just avoid it.
Slides along rows/columns — stay off its axes.
ammonomicon: These great Lead Cubes cannot be killed or halted. Only when the sounds of gunplay have ceased will they go dormant.

name: Flesh Cube
description: Slides towards the player if they line up with it horizontally or vertically, leaving behind a trail of fire. Releases bullets in all directions upon colliding with an obstacle. Cannot be killed. Dies when the room is completed.
location: Black Powder Mine, Hollow, Forge
tips: Invincible — cannot be killed, only dies when the room is cleared.
Leaves a trail of fire — avoid its path.
Releases bullets on wall collisions — don't corner yourself.
ammonomicon: These infernal machines appear to be covered in the flesh of once living creatures.

name: Dead Blow
description: Pounds the ground, leaving a patch of fire and sending fire bullets in all directions. Cannot be killed, and disappears when the room is completed. In some rooms, the Dead Blow will follow the player.
location: Black Powder Mine, Hollow, Forge
tips: Invincible — only disappears when the room is cleared.
Pounds the ground creating fire patches and fire bullets — keep moving.
May follow you in some rooms — stay ahead of it.
ammonomicon: These superheated hammers fill the great Forge, forming an integral step in the production of Bullet Kin.

name: Lead Maiden
description: Hops around, then opens up and fires three rings of triangular bullets that stick to walls, then fire towards the player. Cannot be damaged while closed. Explodes upon death.
location: Black Powder Mine, Hollow, Forge
tips: Invulnerable while closed — only damage when open.
Bullets stick to walls then fire at you — keep moving after they stick.
Explodes on death — don't stand next to it when finishing it.
ammonomicon: Impenetrable when closed.

name: Fridge Maiden
description: Hops around, then opens up and fires three rings of triangular bullets that stick to walls, then fire towards the player. Cannot be damaged while closed. Explodes upon death. A tougher variant of the Lead Maiden found on later floors.
location: Hollow, Forge
tips: Same as Lead Maiden but appears on later floors — invulnerable while closed.
Explodes on death — maintain distance when finishing.

name: Misfire Beast
description: Camouflages itself and creates projections that attack the player with bullet whips.
location: Hollow, Forge
tips: Camouflages itself — watch for shimmer or movement.
Creates projections that attack with bullet whips — track the real one.
ammonomicon: Misfire Beasts are invisible predators who use deadly bullet whips to attack their prey.

name: Phaser Spider
description: Fires large web-shaped sprays of bullets at the player that leave slowing cobwebs on the floor. Frequently burrows into the ground and reappears elsewhere in the room.
location: Hollow, Forge
tips: Fires web-shaped bullet sprays — avoid the web pattern.
Leaves slowing cobwebs on the floor — don't walk through them.
Burrows and reappears — track its emergence point.
ammonomicon: The phaser spider combines two worrying features: the ability to fire bullets, and being a spider.

name: Killithid
description: Summons portals around the room that fire bullets towards the player. Occasionally splits into three copies of itself, two of which are illusions.
location: Hollow, Forge
tips: Creates bullet portals — avoid standing in their line of fire.
Splits into 3 copies (2 illusions) — hit the real one to damage it.
Illusions disappear when hit — shoot all three to find the real one.
ammonomicon: The Killithid exist in a dimension of psychic gunplay, where the need for a physical gun is superfluous. They detest sunlight, and inhabit only the deepest chambers of the Gungeon. Killithid predate the Gungeon, and their magic is some of the first to be documented in the universe.

name: Gripmaster
description: Hovers over the player and attempts to grab them. If the player is successfully grabbed, it will shoot the player to a previously cleared room, which will be reset and have all enemies respawned. Automatically dies if all other enemies in the room are killed.
location: Hollow, Forge
tips: Grabs you and sends you to a previously cleared room — avoid its shadow.
Dies automatically when all other enemies are killed — ignore it if possible.
The grabbed room resets all enemies — avoid getting grabbed at all costs.
ammonomicon: This strange creature possesses a small fraction of the Gungeon's mysterious time manipulation abilities.

name: Dragun Knifeguy
description: Thrown by the High Dragun. Sticks into the wall, periodically firing rapid arcing bursts of bullets away from themselves.Does not actively target the player.
location: Forge (High Dragun fight)
tips: Sticks into walls and fires arcing bursts away from itself.
Doesn't target you directly — avoid standing in its firing arc.
Summoned by the High Dragun — ignore unless in your path.

name: Advanced Dragun Knifeguy
description: Thrown by the Advanced Dragun. Sticks into the wall, periodically firing a loose spread of extremely rapid kunai towards the player, telegraphed by red trajectory lines.
location: Forge (Advanced Dragun fight)
tips: Fires kunai towards you with red trajectory lines — dodge the lines.
Telegraphed by red lines — react to the telegraph, not the kunai.

name: Tarnisher
description: Sinks into the floor and chases the player.  If it successfully catches the player, it will deal damage, partially drain the current gun's ammo, and reduce the magazine size of all of the player's guns until they pick up ammo.
location: Hollow, Forge
tips: Hides under the floor and chases you — watch for the ground ripple.
Drains ammo and reduces magazine size — avoid at all costs.
Deals contact damage plus the ammo drain — very disruptive.
ammonomicon: Half-holster, half-monster, the Tarnisher subsists on an diet largely consisting of guns. Strangely, this makes it both a bottom-feeder and an apex predator within the Gungeon.

name: Shambling Round
description: Has three stages that it progresses through as it takes damage. In its first stage, it fires rings of bullets in all directions. In its second stage, it rapidly alternates between firing bullets out of its left and right sides. In its third stage, it sprays numerous bullets in all directions. Upon death, it leaves behind a cap that explodes after a short delay.
location: Hollow, Forge
tips: Three stages — each more aggressive than the last.
Stage 1: radial rings. Stage 2: side-alternating fire. Stage 3: omni-directional spray.
Death cap explodes after a delay — don't stand on it.
ammonomicon: A totemic offering to the seven armed Goddess of Bullets.

name: Shelleton
description: Slowly walks towards the player, frequently firing two wide bursts of bullets at the player. Occasionally fires a laser at the player. Collapses upon death, and will revive if not destroyed after a short period of time.
location: Gungeon Proper, Abbey of the True Gun, Black Powder Mine, Hollow, Forge
tips: Revives if not destroyed after death — shoot the corpse.
Fires wide bursts and a laser — dodge the laser by staying mobile.
High health (78) — use high-DPS weapons.
ammonomicon: Shelletons are hellish servants to the dark power that was banished to the 6th Chamber.

name: Agonizer
description: Periodically spews bullets in all directions.
location: Gungeon Proper, Abbey of the True Gun, Black Powder Mine
tips: Spews bullets in all directions — find gaps and stay mobile.
Moderate health (50) — manageable with sustained fire.
ammonomicon: The suffering of those lost to Bullet Hell given form.

name: Revolvenant
description: Stretches its arm towards the player, attaching it to a wall. The arm will then release bullets perpendicular to itself. The arms might also form a circle around the player, which follows the movement of the player and will shoot bullets at them.
location: Gungeon Proper, Abbey of the True Gun, Black Powder Mine, Hollow
tips: Arms attach to walls and fire perpendicular bullets — avoid the arm lines.
Can form a circle around you — break out before it closes.
High health (90) — prioritize or use cover.
ammonomicon: Dread sorcerer knights who studied Ammomancy under the creator of the Gungeon himself.

name: Bullet Mech
description: Lumbers towards the player, periodically pausing to jump twice in a row.On the first jump, it releases a diamond-shaped blast of bullets similar to a Cubulon's attack. On the second jump it releases a circular ring of 12 bullets.
location: Hollow, Forge
tips: Double jump: first releases a diamond blast, second a 12-bullet ring.
Dodge between the two jumps — the ring is the harder one to avoid.

name: Gunreaper
description: Swings its scythe, sending a homing arc of bullets towards the player. Cannot be killed, and disappears upon completing the room.
location: Bullet Hell
tips: Invincible — cannot be killed, only disappears when the room is cleared.
Sends homing bullet arcs — keep moving and dodge perpendicular.
Focus on clearing other enemies to make it vanish.
ammonomicon: Death waits for us all.

name: Lord of the Jammed
description: Swings its scythe, sending bullets in all directions. Cannot be killed, and follows the player through rooms and across floors.
location: All floors (at high Curse)
tips: Appears at 10+ Curse — invincible and follows you through rooms and floors.
Sends bullets in all directions — keep your distance.
Reduce curse to make it disappear — or kill the High Dragun fast.
ammonomicon: When the screams of the Jammed reach a fevered pitch, this sentinel will be called forth from beyond the Curtain.

name: Bullet Kin Titan
description: Walks slowly towards the player, firing large, slow-moving bullets in spreads of fire.
location: Gungeon Proper, Abbey of the True Gun, Black Powder Mine
tips: Fires large slow-moving bullets — easy to see but hard to dodge in groups.
High health (80) — use high-DPS weapons.

name: Bullet Kin Titan Boss
description:
Walks slowly towards the player, firing large bullets in three-way spreads, in bursts of three.
Will occasionally fire with predictive aim, taking the player's movement into account.
location: Gungeon Proper (miniboss)
tips: Miniboss (100 HP) — fires 3-way spreads in bursts of 3.
Occasionally uses predictive aim — don't move in straight lines.
Large slow bullets — easier to see but harder to dodge in groups.

name: Bullet Gal Titan Boss
description: Walks slowly towards the player, firing large bullets in three-way spreads, in bursts of three. A female variant of the Bullet Kin Titan Boss with slightly lower health. Will occasionally fire with predictive aim, taking the player movement into account.
location: Gungeon Proper (miniboss)
tips: Miniboss (80 HP) — same attacks as Bullet Kin Titan Boss.
Slightly lower health — but still a significant threat.

name: Fuselier
description: A mini-boss that flies around the top of the screen and rains down various attacks.
location: Oubliette (miniboss)
tips: Mini-boss (450 HP) — flies at the top of the screen.
Rains various attacks — stay mobile and look up.
Summons Bomb Bots — clear them before they reach you.
ammonomicon: A terrible fusion of wick and bomb, this floating creature makes its home inside of a giant bomb.

name: Blockner
description: A secret boss in the Black Powder Mine, encountered after completing Ser Manuel's quest. Spawns with two Gun Nuts as bodyguards. Attacks with rapid fire, wide spreads, and a shield-shaped bullet pattern with a spinning cross. Believes blocking is superior to dodge rolling.
location: Secret — Black Powder Mine
tips: Deal with the two Gun Nuts first to reduce pressure.
Find the secret room in the Halls of Knowledge and bring Old Knight's Helm and Shield to trigger this encounter.
His shield-shaped attack has gaps — weave through them rather than dodge rolling.
ammonomicon: Formerly Ser Blockner, this traitorous rat betrayed his friend and sought glory alone in the Gungeon. Known for using shields and expressing a casual disdain for all dodge rolls. Eventually met his end at the hands of one of Ser Manuel's pupils.

name: Shadow Magician
description: Fires bullets in magical spell patterns and twirls across the room.
location: Hollow (miniboss)
tips: Mini-boss (450 HP) — fires magical spell patterns.
Twirls across the room — track its movement to dodge.
Found in the Hollow — appears as a random miniboss.
ammonomicon: Seemingly controlled by an unseen master, this mysterious form recently began stalking the Chambers of the Gungeon.
